_comment: Template only — no real hostnames, IPs, or serials. Fill in against your actual environment before running.

direct_firewalls._comment: Any firewall reachable directly on its own management hostname, not Panorama-managed. 'site' is optional (defaults to UNSPECIFIED) — used only for evidence traceability, has no effect on collection.

panorama_managed_firewalls._comment: Serial is required (used for the Panorama target= proxy for license info). host is optional — omit it if this firewall is not directly network-reachable, but profiles/rules/logs will then be skipped for it (see main.py docstring).
